scope: Read-only use of existing Y2/Y3 VTU, modal manifest, auxiliary-output and stage files. No mesh, FE, matrix, factor, PDE, resource-stream read, or source edit.

static_solver_findings.residual_evaluator: src/solvers/p6_cell_condensed_action.py:1132-1304 computes native_residual = native_effective_rhs - native_apply(recovered_storage). The runner callback at src/runners/p6_condensed_direct.py:2180-2192 applies bundle["physical_action"], which is the sum of the p6 volume action and DtN action. Therefore native_residual is the full active physical A6 residual (with the effective RHS), not an FE-block-only residual.
static_solver_findings.distinct_augmented_blocks: The same evaluator separately returns augmented_fe_residual and augmented_port_residual, plus port_residual_relative, retained_alpha, and the reduced Schur residual/identities. These are distinct block/unknown diagnostics; they must not be conflated with native_residual.
static_solver_findings.runner_persistence: src/runners/p6_condensed_direct.py:2201-2229 persists condensed_direct_relative and the full active native A6 relative/identity facts. It does not persist augmented_fe_residual, augmented_port_residual, port_residual_relative, or the MUMPS-retained alpha vector. The condensed_direct_relative is the aggregate reduced trace+port residual, not a standalone port-block residual.
static_solver_findings.output_auxiliary: src/solvers/fullspace_same_mesh_hcurl_pmg_physical.py:890-908 calls dtn_action.recover_auxiliary(solution); src/solvers/fullspace_dtn_action.py:602-619 recomputes H_p^{-1}D_p u from the recovered storage. That output is not a serialization of the MUMPS-retained alpha from evaluate_native_residual.
static_solver_findings.field_output: restore_p0_full_field at src/solvers/fullspace_same_mesh_hcurl_pmg_physical.py:983-1004 scatters, homogenizes, and back-substitutes the zero-slave storage before DG6 field export. The projected output field is MPC-expanded; auxiliary recovery is recomputed from the original saved storage vector.

vtu_reconstruction.writer: save_airbox_3d_fields writes vector DG6 interpolation, physical E/H fields and VTU point arrays; incident_e0_V_per_m=1.0 for both runs.
vtu_reconstruction.space_relation: The live N1curl element is Basix N1E degree 6, Legendre variant, covariantPiola, dimension 882. Random reference-cell N1E vectors reconstructed in scalar tensor DG6 (343 nodes/component, gll_warped) had relative L2 error 1.198103498792856e-15 and max absolute 7.731540852509763e-13. Affine axis-aligned hex Piola maps are constant, so the local polynomial space is contained in vector DG6.
vtu_reconstruction.vtk_mapping: DOLFINx plot.vtk_mesh(FunctionSpace) returns V.tabulate_dof_coordinates and cell dof-map connectivity (permuted for VTK). Field arrays are reshaped in the same dof order by postprocess_3d._values. The audit mapped by physical coordinates rather than VTK parametric coordinates.
vtu_reconstruction.q_rule_check: Basix quadrilateral default q28 has 225 points (15x15); q60 has 961 (31x31). Analytic single-mode projection against the manifest denominator differed from 1 by at most 5.684341886080802e-14.

projection_method.functional: Integrate saved DG6 E_t dot conjugate(e_t * exp(i*(alpha*x + gamma*y + kz*z))) over the actual top/bottom cell faces; divide by the same manifest projection_denominator = area * electric_tangential_norm_sq * abs(boundary_phase)^2.
projection_method.complex_inner: UFL inner(a,b) conjugates its second argument; the offline formula follows the production _mode_projection_from_solution convention.

sidewall_mapping_only.interpretation: VTU is cellwise DG6: coordinate-aligned interface points are duplicated per cell. The audit checked cell/material/face mapping and component selection only; it did not compare jumps or claim physical discontinuity/continuity.

limitations_and_next_evidence: Top m=±4,n=0,p offline projections disagree with the saved carrier-reprojection values even though q28 and q60 agree to about 3.3e-16 in boundary amplitude; the discrepancy is not explained by q28 underintegration alone.

The projection is cancellation-sensitive: weighted-integrand absolute-sum/result condition is about 9.34e2 (Y2) and 2.48e6 (Y3). This condition number is diagnostic, not proof that it explains the discrepancy.

No original p6 coefficient checkpoint, retained MUMPS alpha vector, or saved per-mode augmented-port residual is available. Therefore the difference cannot yet be attributed to carrier assembly, MPC expansion/dual mapping, recovery, or output reconstruction.

The native A6 residual is the full active physical operator residual, including both the volume action and DtN action; it is not a separate FE-block residual. The evaluator computes a distinct augmented FE-block residual and a distinct port-block residual, but the runner did not persist those vectors/scalars or the retained MUMPS alpha.
No canonical sidewall H(curl) trace was reconstructed. The saved DG6 VTU supports geometric mapping and tangential-component selection only.

supersedes.note: v1 is retained as the original audit snapshot; its residual classification was corrected here.
